Reasoning: This release stage is represented as keeping the current panda_fingertip pose fixed while opening the gripper. The freeze_position term enforces no Cartesian translation of the panda_fingertip frame with the required 0.01 m tolerance. The freeze_orientation term enforces no rotation of the panda_fingertip frame with the required 0.05 rad tolerance, preserving the current tool axes. The open_gripper term commands the bilateral gripper fingers to open and marks success on the opened gripper state. The API has no explicit term for finger contact/effort feedback, avoiding finger contact with specific objects, or verifying that cube_3 is no longer grasped by contact sensing. The required cube_3-on-cube_2 and cube_2-on-cube_1 placement-maintenance clauses would require additional object position constraints, but the operator rules allow at most one position op in the whole list, so those object placement clauses are omitted.
